subject: Post-call executive wrap-up: business outcomes, risks, and procurement path
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@altiushealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@altiushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 19:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call executive wrap-up: business outcomes, risks, and procurement path

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive discussion today. Quick executive-level recap and recommended next steps so your sponsor group has a single doc to share internally. I focused this on outcomes, immediate risks, and the procurement lane we discussed.

Key business outcomes we aligned on
- Reduce inference cost per query by ~40% for your anonymized chart summarization pipeline while preserving F1 > 0.92 on key entity extraction.
- Achieve 99th-percentile latency < 300ms for high-velocity triage queries (50 QPS target) for the initial pilot.
- Shorten clinician turnaround on automated notes by ~30% (projected productivity gain / pilot).

Primary pain points you shared
- Current service fails over at 15 QPS which breaks peak triage workflows.
- Vendor lock-in concerns with current model hosting and limited observability for token-level costs.
- SOC2 audit evidence gaps and SSO/KMS controls needed for enterprise procurement.

Top risks & proposed mitigations (exec view)
- Risk: Latency spikes during morning load -> Mitigation: Redwood Dedicated can reserve a GPU pool with autoscale headroom + prefix KV caching for hot prompts.
- Risk: Compliance gating around PHI -> Mitigation: Private deployment with customer-managed VPC + KMS integration (we can deliver audit log samples).
- Risk: Procurement timeline slipping -> Mitigation: We propose a mutual action plan (attached) with a 6-week pilot SOW and a DocuSign path for standard MSA + Data Addendum.

Procurement path we recommend (high level)
1) Pilot SOW (6 weeks) — restricted dataset, dedicated GPU pool for target throughput.
2) Security review — share SOC2 artifacts + sample audit logs (we can provide within 48 hours).
3) Commercial terms — standard MSA + 3-month reserved capacity option if pilot metrics met.
4) Enterprise rollout — Dedicated -> Optional Private for PHI workloads.

Escalation triggers to call out to execs (so sponsors know when to escalate)
- Pilot misses 99th pct latency target for 2 consecutive weeks.
- Security review flags that cannot be closed within 10 business days.
- Sustained QPS beyond pilot that would require >2x reserved capacity without committed spend.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan-alt4521.xlsx (pilot milestones + ownership), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (latency/cost SLOs).

Proposed immediate next steps (owner / ETA)
- Alicia: Confirm pilot dataset and legal contact (Procurement/IT) by Fri 10/9.
- Rachel: Share SOC2 excerpts and sample audit logs; propose pilot SOW draft by Tue 10/13.
- Ben: Schedule a 45-min ops runbook review with your platform team (suggest Wed 10/14).

If this aligns, I'll convert the mutual action plan into a short DocuSign and loop legal contacts. Happy to consolidate this into a one-pager for your CFO / procurement lead.

Thanks again — appreciate everyone's time.

--
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan-alt4521.xlsx]
[Attachment: redwood-sla-summary.pdf]

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@altiushealth.com>

Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call executive wrap-up: business outcomes, risks, and procurement path

Thanks Rachel — this is very helpful and exactly the level our sponsor group needs. Quick notes:

- We confirm the pilot dataset (de-identified triage notes) and I will share a secure S3 location by EOD Thu 10/8.
- Procurement contact: Tom Ellis (cc'd) will lead contracting and IT security review. Tom, loop in compliance and let us know the preferred evidence package.
- Timeline: Sponsor wants vendor review completed within 3 weeks if possible. Does Redwood have a standardized evidence packet?

Also: two asks from our side
1) Can you include a short one-page table that maps Redwood controls to our Audit Evidence checklist (I can share the checklist).
2) We need confirmation that the pilot will not route PHI off our VPC — any data movement details you can confirm now would help.

Appreciate this — Alicia

Alicia / Tom —

Perfect — thanks for the quick alignment. A few clarifications and the immediate plan:

- Evidence packet: Marissa will assemble a mapping table (Redwood control -> Altius checklist) and a redacted SOC2 excerpt. We will deliver that by EOD Fri 10/9.
- Data movement: For the pilot we recommend a Private deployment into your VPC; that ensures logs and raw content never leave your network. If Altius prefers Hosted pilot, we'll provide a strict ingress-only S3 flow and KMS-wrapped keys; however, for PHI we recommend Private.
- DocuSign / contracting: I'll convert the attached mutual action plan into DocuSign and include a 6-week SOW. Tom, if you can share your procurement contact email, we'll route the MSA + Data Addendum quickly.

I'll schedule the ops runbook (Ben) and the security evidence walkthrough (Marissa) for next week and include all materials in a single shared Drive folder.

Next sync: propose Wed 10/14 @ 10:00 AM PT for the ops+security working session — let me know if that works.

Thanks — Rachel
